faq.q: How long does a website take?
faq.a:
It depends on the size. Most sites take from a few days to a couple of weeks.
Reach out to us for better clarity and better inquiry.

faq.q: What do I need to submit for your service?
faq.a: Your business name, logo, photos and the main details. If you do not have photos yet, we can start with placeholders and also build up from scratch for you.

faq.q: Who pays for the domain and hosting?
faq.a: These are included in our service invoice. We explain any hosting or domain cost before we start and their duration according to your preferences.

faq.q: Can I edit the site myself?
faq.a: Yes. Your site comes with a simple admin page for changing text, photos and prices. This is an optional offer.
